jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Tech GRC M&A
jobs.description:
The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. is one of the world’s leading manufacturers, marketers, and sellers of quality skin care, makeup, fragrance, and hair care products, and is a steward of luxury and prestige brands globally. The company’s products are sold in approximately 150 countries and territories under brand names including: Estée Lauder, Aramis, Clinique, Lab Series, Origins, M·A·C, La Mer, Bobbi Brown Cosmetics, Aveda, Jo Malone London, Bumble and bumble, Darphin Paris, TOM FORD, Smashbox, AERIN Beauty, Le Labo, Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle, GLAMGLOW, KILIAN PARIS, Too Faced, Dr.Jart+, the DECIEM family of brands, including The Ordinary and NIOD, and BALMAIN Beauty.
Description

This role will support the evangelization of an application security strategy under the direction of the Global Head of Application Security in support of ELC's strategic and tactical initiatives in application modernization, DevSecOps, artificial intelligence & robotics, multi⁃cloud adoption, and multi⁃site application development. This position will directly contribute to the overall global security of ELC's applications, under the direction of the Global Head of Application Security. This candidate will primarily be focused on ensuring security is built into the Software Development Life Cycle, and the delivery of trusted products and services to our clients, partners, and ELC IT/Security associates.

These responsibilities will be fulfilled by performing application security tests, developing and providing secure source code consultation services, and assisting the development communities with self⁃service tools. A person in this position will work within a diverse and geographically disperse team, as well as, act as a coach and mentor for developing the skill sets of junior team members.

Must have excellent track record and proven ability to produce effective, innovative solutions at an enterprise scale. Must be constantly evaluating the evolving security, application and technology industries to be on top of the latest innovations and process refinements, making recommendations and influencing adoption by IT, ECR and the broader ELC community.

Main duties:

- Review current security processes used in our Software Engineering teams & develop optimization strategies.

- Work with the development teams to coordinate and perform vulnerability assessments through the use of automated and manual tools.

- Provide consulting & mentoring expertise to our Developers, DevOps, and Software Engineering teams in a dynamic environment to promote and implement the DevSecOps program across our organization.

- Ability to review and analyze vulnerability data to identify security risks to the organization's network, infrastructure, and application's and determine any reported vulnerabilities that are false positives.

- Provide the expertise to prepare security vulnerability and risk management reports for management and other key stakeholders.

- Ensure we deploy best practice Cloud Configuration and Security Management tools and processes into our Software Engineering teams.

- Provide leadership and teaming skills to coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities within established timeframes.

- Experience operating in agile development processes and integrating secure development practices into these models.

- Excellent programming and scripting skills in languages such as C#, C/C++, Java, JavaScript, PowerShell, Python, etc.

- Experience with APIs: REST, SOAP, SOA and other integrations

- Formal training in the primary development toolset: Tools, Code, Application Engine, SQL/DB Security

Qualifications

- Good knowledge and understanding of application security vulnerabilities (SANS, OWASP).

- Knowledge of Threat modelling and risk analysis.

- Candidate should be very thorough in internet technologies and highly versed with web development best practices.

- Strong analytical/problem solving skills and cross functional knowledge across multiple development and security disciplines.

- Understanding of Test Automation tools and frameworks such as SAST, DAST, IAST.

- Ability to communicate security⁃related concepts to a broad range of technical and non⁃technical staff.

- Must possess a high degree of integrity, be trustworthy, and have the ability to lead and inspire change.

- Previous software engineering/architecture experience (Java, C#,.Net, JavaScript) preferred.

- Understanding CI/CD pipelines covering source control, integration, and deployment (ex: Bitbucket, Jenkins, JIRA, Artifactory, Nexus, git).

- Knowledge in securing cloud deployment and containers (familiarity with Ansible, DeMisto, Docker, and/or Kubernetes).

- Some experience with development of RESTful and SOAP web services preferred.

- Understanding of advanced iterative Agile methodologies.

- Familiarity with micro services architecture and design Patterns.

Pay Range:

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $90,450.00   to $135,000.00 .  Exact salary depends on several factors such as experience, skills, education, and budget. Salary range may vary based on geographic location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in a highly competitive bonus program with the possibility for overachievement based on performance and company results.

Description

-
Executive Director, Consumer Data Strategy & Operations

Role Overview

The Executive Director, Consumer Data Strategy & Operations will lead the development of ELC's consumer data capabilities, audience foundations and governance frameworks as part of the new Growth Marketing & media organization. This role is responsible for establishing the enterprise capabilities required to enable audience-led marketing across ELC, ensuring consumer data can be consistently activated, and measured.

Working closely with IT and Privacy teams, the Executive Director will define the standards, frameworks, and capabilities required to unlock greater value from ELC's first-party data assets and enable future growth across paid and owned channels. The role will establish a common approach to consumer data management, audience governance and segmentation, creating the foundations required for more effective marketing execution.

Qualifications

-
Establish ELC's Consumer Data Strategy & Foundations

- Define the enterprise vision and roadmap for consumer data capabilities aligned to ELC's broader marketing transformation.

- Establish global consumer data standards, taxonomies, and foundational frameworks that can be adopted consistently across brands and affiliates.

- Partner closely with Privacy, Legal, Security, and IT teams to ensure consumer data practices align with global regulatory requirements and internal governance standards.

- Partner closely with other functions, regions and affiliates to define and prioritize global use cases to inform IT roadmaps.

- Drive value realization from consumer data investments through strong adoption, governance, and cross-functional collaboration.

Define Global Audience Segmentation Frameworks

- Lead development of ELC's global segmentation framework, creating a common approach that can be adopted across brands, categories, and markets.

- Define methodologies for identifying high-value consumer groups and monitor performance insights over time.

- Partner to ensure segmentation and audience capabilities are embedded within media planning, audience strategy, and measurement frameworks.

Build Global Consumer Data Operating Model

- Define the future-state operating model for consumer data across global, regional, and local teams.

- Establish global governance frameworks for audience creation, management, activation, and measurement across global EBS and media agency partners.

- Develop scalable ways of working that improve accessibility, usability, and adoption of consumer data capabilities across the enterprise.

Capability Building & Organizational Enablement

- Build enterprise understanding of consumer data, audience management, segmentation, identity, and governance principles.

- Create capability-building programs, playbooks, and communities of practice that accelerate adoption of audience-led marketing across ELC.

- Establish a global community of consumer data practitioners to share best practices, learnings, and innovation opportunities.

- Drive adoption of common consumer data standards and audience capabilities across brands and affiliates.

- Build and mentor a high-performing team while fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, governance, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Sr. Analyst, Treasury Operations
jobs.description:
The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. is one of the world’s leading manufacturers, marketers, and sellers of quality skin care, makeup, fragrance, and hair care products, and is a steward of luxury and prestige brands globally. The company’s products are sold in approximately 150 countries and territories under brand names including: Estée Lauder, Aramis, Clinique, Lab Series, Origins, M·A·C, La Mer, Bobbi Brown Cosmetics, Aveda, Jo Malone London, Bumble and bumble, Darphin Paris, TOM FORD, Smashbox, AERIN Beauty, Le Labo, Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle, GLAMGLOW, KILIAN PARIS, Too Faced, Dr.Jart+, the DECIEM family of brands, including The Ordinary and NIOD, and BALMAIN Beauty.
Description

The Senior Analyst, Treasury Operations, reports to the Senior Manager, Treasury Operations, and supports the execution, monitoring, and reporting of treasury activities under the manager’s direction. The role assists with daily cash operations, month-end and quarter-end close activities, journal entries, cash and liquidity reporting, and quarterly reporting. The successful candidate will build a strong understanding of the business and its treasury processes, prepare accurate analyses and recommendations for review by the Senior Manager, and support the delivery of treasury information to senior management.

Key responsibilities include:

- Support the daily cash operations, including cash positioning, cash reporting and forecasting, short-term investments, wire payments, fraud prevention, bank account administration, merchant card processing, and banking relationships.

- Develop and maintain financial models to forecast and manage cash and liquidity.

- Support the preparation of short-term liquidity forecasts and analyses to senior management.

- Support processes and procedures associated with month-end and quarter-end close activities.

- Evaluate products, services, technologies, and systems that support best-in-class treasury operations.

- Evaluate and ensure compliance with internal controls, policies, and procedures, and support internal and external audits.

- Support treasury system upgrades and implementations, and liaise with Treasury, IT, external vendors, and consultants.

- Generate and publish foreign exchange rates and verify that they are accurately uploaded into SAP.

- Prepare month-end and quarter-end reconciliations and reports, investigate discrepancies.

- Analyze bank fees to confirm that charges are accurate and appropriately allocated among relationship banking partners.

- Administer user access within Bank Portals and the Treasury Workstation, ensuring that access rights are appropriate and properly controlled.

- Manage Treasury invoice processing and ensure the timely payment of vendor and supplier invoices.

- Ensure that all wire transfers and cash management activities are completed accurately and on time.

- Analyze cash balances to optimize investments while preventing account overdrafts.

- Prepare and present weekly cash analysis reports to senior management.

- Ensure adherence to all controls and maintain an efficient banking and cash management structure.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Operations Manager Lachen
jobs.description:
Description

With a diverse portfolio of more than 20 brands sold in approximately 150 countries and territories, Estée Lauder Companies is the global leader in prestige beauty, recognized for its skincare, make-up, fragrances, and hair care products.  In Switzerland, Estée Lauder has the main Supply Chain Hub for Travel Retail and EMEA, offering many opportunities across multiple functions to grow your career and become part of our amazing Supply Chain teams.

We are now hiring a Manufacturing Operations Manager Lachen for our Manufacturing in Lachen, Switzerland.

As Manufacturing Operations Manager Lachen , you will lead the end-to-end operations of our Filling, Assembly, and Compounding departments, overseeing a team of 80-100 employees. Your mission: to ensure safety, quality, service, and cost targets are not only met but exceeded. You’ll be a key driver of continuous improvement, team empowerment, and strategic alignment with our global manufacturing model.

Your Responsibilities Include:

- Lead daily operations across Filling, Assembly and Compounding.

- Ensure compliance with GMP, safety, and quality standards.

- Develop and execute annual plans and budgets aligned with business goals.

- Roadmap & Target Achievement: Develop a clear roadmap to reach yearly targets, translating strategic objectives into actionable steps and ensuring alignment with business priorities.

- Drive continuous improvement using Lean, TPM, and OpEx principles.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Planning, QA, HR, Finance, and Logistics.

.

- Coach and develop your team, fostering a high-performance culture.

- SOP Leadership: Lead and own work instructions and SOPs together with the team, ensuring compliance, clarity, and alignment with regulatory requirements; provide regular updates and ensure readiness for audits.

- OMP Ownership: Take full ownership for the Operational Masterplan (OMP) of F&A ensuring visibility, tracking, and delivery of performance commitments.

- Problem Solving & Maintenance: Apply structured problem-solving methodologies to address process deviations and equipment issues, while strengthening preventive and autonomous maintenance skills across the team.

- Change Leadership: Act as a change agent in transformation projects, promoting engagement, knowledge transfer, and sustainable results within the team.

- Best Practice Sharing: Share learnings, improvements, and best practices to foster knowledge exchange, standardization, and global collaboration across sites.

- Support new product launches and strategic site initiatives.

- Champion ELC values and act as a cultural ambassador across the plant.

What we are looking for:

- A bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or higher.

- Minimum of 5+ years in manufacturing leadership, ideally in GMP-regulated industries.

- Fluent in German and English.

- Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.

- Proven budget management and strategic planning capabilities.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and relevant industry software.

- Excellent problem-solving, communication, and organizational abilities

We offer you:

- a fantastic opportunity to work in an international, fast-paced, and high-touch environment

- a nurturing and challenging culture that is respectful of our roots and promotes intensive career development across multiple functions

- to be part of a company that creates prestige beauty products that also advance sustainability and help contribute to a stable climate and a healthy, beautiful planet

- inclusion, diversity, and equity which are natural extensions of The Estée Lauder Companies’ values

- amazing support for your work-life balance (gym allowance, only a 40-hour workweek)

-  personal development opportunities via our internal training hub, LinkedIn Learning, and external educational trainings

- access to our employee staff shop, the possibility to buy Reka checks with a discount, and free parking spaces for all our employees

Is this position relevant and interesting for you? Then apply online now!

Responsible for providing leadership at a Corporate level at ELC across Affiliates, Regions, Brands, Functional Departments and Channels. This individual will provide Executive Management with insights on the business through enhanced analyses and reporting, with a focus on analyzing global expense estimate reporting.

2.    Lead the Corporate FP&A planning process with a focus on consumer-centric financial planning, specifically as it relates to consolidating and analyzing operating expense estimate reporting

- Experience building complex analytical models

- Strong PC skills including SAP, OneStream, PowerPoint and particularly Excel, with the ability to work with data efficiently and effectively

jobs.title: Global SD & VM Operations Manager
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:
Within the Store Design & VM department for Kilian Paris & Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle, we are looking for a Global SD & VM Operations Manager with a comprehensive skill set in VM indirect procurement, project management, creative oversight, financial control, and administrative coordination.
This role involves managing and directing retail projects within our creative department, ensuring the successful delivery of projects while adhering to budgets and timelines. The ideal candidate will be responsible for producing VM collateral, planning, coordinating, and executing projects across various platforms, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring that all projects align with the company's goals and objectives.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

Project Planning and Coordination:
• Develop realistic budgets and timelines, providing regular project updates.
• Liaise with various departments to establish project specifications and schedules.
• Monitor project risks, escalate issues when necessary, and manage out-of-scope requests.

Leadership and Coordination:
• Develop forecasting bulletins (for permanent and launch materials) and verify forecast accuracy with regions and markets.
• Track and deliver VM and retail materials, managing production schedules and warehouse deliveries.
• Monitor project budgets and production activities, communicating status updates and issues to relevant teams.

VM Collateral Production (Indirect Procurement):
• Scout and negotiate with suitable suppliers based on project requirements.
• Strong knowledge of design, assembly materials, and production techniques.
• Established network of suppliers, shopfitters, artisans, artists, and related partners.
• Produce VM tools, window displays, mock-ups, and related materials.
• Establish production timelines and maintain budget control in collaboration with external partners.
• Work closely with vendors to ensure timely delivery of all creative materials.

Financial and Administrative Management:
• Monitor internal and external project costs and ensure adherence to budgets.
• Manage the administrative aspects of the SD & VM department.
• Create purchase orders and track actual versus budgeted vendor costs.
• Generate monthly budget reports for finance teams and maintain project documentation.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:
• Minimum 8 years of experience in retail design for luxury brands as an in-house project manager.
• Proven project management skills.
• Self-motivated with a strong desire to expand knowledge and expertise.
• Experience developing and negotiating project scopes and budgets with cross-functional teams.
• Ability to work autonomously while managing multiple teams and projects under tight deadlines.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues at all levels.
